verification: learnMoreLink reads 'About FitShield' in English and is defined in zero non-English locales, so all 82 now fall back to the current English rather than to the retired 'Visit fitshield.net'. I scanned every one of the 83 catalogs for that exact retired string and found no occurrences, and locale-parity pins it by exact string in its RETIRED_ENGLISH table independently of the digest baseline. The finding also asked for a check that flags any non-English message that is pure-ASCII Latin in a non-Latin-script locale. That check did not exist, so I implemented englishInNonLatinScript() in tools/locale-hybrid-audit.js: it classifies a locale by the script its own corpus actually uses and reports entries that are pure Latin and byte-identical to English, exempting only proper nouns. On first run it found 761 such entries across 39 locales, which were then translated or deleted, and the check now guards the corpus.
evidenceAfter: 0 of 83 locales contain 'Visit fitshield.net'; englishInNonLatinScript() reports 0 stranded entries
